claim: The Directory Service 'Which to choose' table says: use AWS Managed Microsoft AD (Standard or Enterprise Edition) for an actual Microsoft AD in the cloud or LDAP for Linux apps; Hybrid Edition to extend an existing self-managed AD into AWS; AD Connector if you only need on-premises users to log in to AWS applications with their AD credentials (it can also join EC2 instances to the existing domain); Simple AD for a low-scale, low-cost directory with basic AD compatibility. Simple AD is no longer open to new customers; for similar capabilities AWS points to AWS Managed Microsoft AD or AD Connector.

evidence.quote:
| I need Active Directory or LDAP for my applications in the cloud | Use **AWS Directory Service for Microsoft Active Directory** (Standard Edition or Enterprise Edition) if you need an actual Microsoft Active Directory in the AWS Cloud that supports Active Directory–aware workloads, or AWS applications and services such as Amazon WorkSpaces and Amazon Quick, or you need LDAP support for Linux applications.
Use **AWS Directory Service for Microsoft Active Directory** (Hybrid Edition) to extend your existing self-managed AD into the AWS Cloud with AWS Directory Service
Use **AD Connector** if you only need to allow your on-premises users to log in to AWS applications and services with their Active Directory credentials. You can also use AD Connector to join Amazon EC2 instances to your existing Active Directory domain.
Use **Simple AD** if you need a low-scale, low-cost directory with basic Active Directory compatibility that supports Samba 4–compatible applications, or you need LDAP compatibility for LDAP-aware applications. |
evidence.table_header: | What do you need to do? | Recommended AWS Directory Service options |

evidence.quote: Simple AD is no longer open to new customers. For capabilities similar to Simple AD, explore AWS Managed Microsoft AD or AD Connector.

note: d085. The row names a Hybrid Edition of AWS Managed Microsoft AD; its GA date is for the numbers+changes lens (examinable cut-off 2026-07-15). Simple AD closed to new customers 2026-07-30 (after the cutoff): older exam questions may still offer Simple AD as the low-cost answer; teach both in a Changed recently note.
